title: SolarWinds Access Rights Manager EndUpdate Exposed Dangerous Method Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SolarWinds Access Rights Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the EndUpdate method. The issue results from an exposed dangerous method.
